title: Faster checkout, CSV exports, and widget dark mode
body: The March release closes out three of the most-requested threads from the feedback board.
points: Checkout is now a single round trip — no more double-charged carts on slow connections.
Export any members view to CSV, filters included.
The What's New widget follows your app's dark mode automatically.

title: Comments on updates
body: Readers can now reply to a release right on your changelog. Comments thread under each update, and mentions of your teammates notify them in Slack.
points: Comments are moderated from the dashboard — hold, approve, or block by domain.
Feature requests raised in a comment can be promoted to your tracker in one click.

title: Smarter drafts for monorepos
body: Signal now understands path-based ownership, so a monorepo merge lands in the right product's changelog instead of one giant feed.
points: Map folders to products once; every future PR routes itself.
Cross-product releases can publish to several changelogs from one draft.

title: Email digests on your schedule
body: Weekly, biweekly, or on every release — digests now batch updates however your audience prefers, with per-subscriber frequency settings.
points: Digest emails inherit your changelog branding automatically.

title: A faster hosted changelog
body: The hosted changelog was rebuilt on edge rendering. Pages now paint in under 100ms worldwide, and RSS feeds update the moment you publish.
points: Median page load dropped from 480ms to 90ms.
Custom domains now provision certificates in seconds.
